title: Yara and the Confession
author: Astrid Joubert
blurb: Zephyrine Crane, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
